The structure of footholds can be temporary, but removing them while following a relaxed heuristic might not be efficient. The edge conditions rely on two positions to move and place variables, meaning all height variables need to be mutually adjacent. It's interesting, but it seems that a complete connected grid can't be factored as a star. What to make of that?
